mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently reduces discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate investment.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS < 600000) and housing starts (HOUST < 1700) indicates broad demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 600000 and HOUST < 1700 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) during high inflation and monetary tightening regimes signals supply-side constraints that reduce corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105.0 during high inflation and monetary tightening but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly non-farm payrolls decline exceeding 50,000 (PAYEMS change < -50.0) indicates immediate labor market weakness that triggers short-term equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS monthly change < -50.0 but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained consumer spending above 620,000 million (RSAFS > 620000) indicates robust household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 620000 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% signals persistent inflation without policy response, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as rate hike expectations rise.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 105.0 (INDPRO < 105.0) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as it signals manufacturing contraction and potential recessionary pressures.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods.
